name: 深度睡眠可拆洗四季宠物窝款

shots.intent: 首屏以深夜月色氛围一秒传达深度睡眠的核心利益，赢得点击

shots.intent: 90° 俯视并排对比面料正面与反面，消除耐磨耐咬的材质疑虑

shots.intent: 高角度特写隐形拉链开合取胆结构，支撑全可拆洗卖点
shots.textZone: 左侧面板白色标题「{callout_1}」+ 两行短句「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 家居角落自然光场景让买家代入四季通用、随时安睡的生活画面
规格表与尺寸标注一次消除选多大、能否放下的疑虑

shots.intent: 多色两码整齐阵列让买家快速对号入座完成选择

shots.intent: 微距包边缝线工艺收口，传递结实耐用的品质安心感

style.backgroundSystem: 深夜蓝夜空底 #16283F 用于首屏与分屏氛围屏，云白 #FFFFFF 与浅灰 #F2F3F5 面板用于信息图与细节屏
style.iconSystem: 细线图标 #8FA8C0、01-06 编号圆片与圆形角标，标签统一圆角
style.lightingSystem: 暗屏用顶部柔和月光感顶光带轻微晕影，亮屏用明亮均匀左前主光棚光，全程软接触阴影
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium night-sleep pet-bedding ecommerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of deep navy night blue #16283F, clean white #FFFFFF, misty blue-grey #8FA8C0 and warm amber accent #F2C94C; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif short headlines with small letter-spaced English sub-captions; thin-line icons, numbered circles and round chips in blue-grey #8FA8C0; dark screens use a soft moon-glow top light with gentle vignette, white screens use bright even studio light with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; bed shown as a stable rounded-rectangular soft volume with realistic washed-fabric texture and a stable hero angle; balanced airy compositions; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: 窝体为稳定圆角矩形软体积，变体与场景保持一致英雄机位，材质真实柔软不塌陷
style.surfaceSystem: 柔软水洗布与短绒面料质感为主，浅灰哑光摄影台面
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif，短标题配小号英文副题，正文极简
